title: Can M4 Pro 48GB Run DeepSeek-R1 32B? VRAM, Speed & CLI Guide
meta_description: Fits (Readable): DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B Q4_K_M uses 22.57 GB at 8K context on Apple M4 Pro (48GB Unified) (36.5 GB usable, 13.9 GB headroom, est. ~8–11 tok/s). Includes GGUF, AWQ, MLX & Uncensored sizing.
verdict_summary: Apple M4 Pro (48GB Unified) fits DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B cleanly at Q4_K_M with 13.91 GB headroom at 8K context (22.57 / 36.5 GB usable; max 40K context @ 30.69 GB (speed drops to ~6–9 tok/s [Readable] at 40K)). Formula throughput at 8K sits in the Readable band (est. ~8–11 tok/s) driven by 273 GB/s memory bandwidth.

context_analysis.bottleneck_summary: DeepSeek-R1 32B Q4_K_M weights occupy 19.88 GB plus 0.69 GB runtime scratchpad, and FP16 KV cache grows by +1.00 GB per 4K tokens (2.00 GB @ 8K). With 36.5 GB usable budget on M4 Pro 48GB, max resident context reaches 40K (30.69 GB total, Fits; speed @ 40K: ~6–9 tok/s). Desktop macOS reserve assumes ~11.5 GB stays wired for WindowServer, browsers, and IDEs; switching to the Clean OS reserve profile recovers extra GB when closing heavy desktop apps.
key_points: Q4_K_M @ 8K requires 22.57 GB total (19.88 GB weights + 2.00 GB FP16 KV + 0.69 GB runtime buffer; est. ~8–11 tok/s).
Max fit context on Q4_K_M reaches 40K (30.69 GB total footprint, Fits; decode @ 40K: ~6–9 tok/s [Readable]).
Higher precision Q8_0 requires 37.72 GB @ 8K (OOM, est. OOM).
Under Apple MLX 4-bit (mlx-lm), DeepSeek-R1 32B uses 21.38 GB of your 36.5 GB realistic Desktop unified pool (Fits; ~9–13 tok/s).
optimization_tips: Set FlashAttention (-fa on) and 8-bit KV cache (-ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0) to nearly halve KV memory growth per 4K tokens.
Prefer mlx-lm 4-bit weights on Apple Silicon for native Metal kernel throughput, or toggle Clean OS reserve before running larger quants.
Remember all tok/s numbers are Physics v3.2 formula estimate ranges (~±15–20%); pairs without a Verified Benchmark remain Formula only (unverified).

faq.question: Does DeepSeek-R1 32B fit cleanly in M4 Pro 48GB VRAM?
faq.answer: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B at Q4_K_M (8K context) needs 22.57 GB vs 36.5 GB usable on Apple M4 Pro (48GB Unified). Status is Fits with 13.91 GB spare headroom (max 40K @ 30.69 GB, ~6–9 tok/s).

faq.question: What token generation speed can I expect for DeepSeek-R1 32B on M4 Pro 48GB?
faq.answer: Physics v3.2 estimates ~8–11 tok/s (Readable) for batch=1 decoding at 8K context (slowing to ~6–9 tok/s at full 40K context). Treat this as a ±15–20% formula range unless backed by a Measured Community Benchmark.

faq.question: Can I run DeepSeek-R1 32B with AWQ (vLLM) or Apple MLX instead of GGUF?
faq.answer: Under Apple MLX 4-bit (mlx-lm), DeepSeek-R1 32B uses 21.38 GB of your 36.5 GB realistic Desktop unified pool (Fits; ~9–13 tok/s).

faq.question: How much context window fits safely without swapping on M4 Pro 48GB?
faq.answer: With FP16 KV cache growing at +1.00 GB per 4K tokens, Q4_K_M clears up to 40K (30.69 GB total footprint), where decode speed adjusts from ~~8–11 tok/s (@ 8K) to ~6–9 tok/s (@ 40K) due to KV reads and attention overhead.

faq.question: Can I run an uncensored, abliterated, or Heretic variant of DeepSeek-R1 32B on M4 Pro 48GB?
faq.answer: Yes — uncensored / abliterated / Heretic community fine-tunes of DeepSeek-R1 32B preserve identical layer counts, hidden widths, and GQA KV cache geometry. Apply the exact same 22.57 GB (Q4_K_M GGUF) or 21.38 GB (MLX_4BIT) 8K memory and tok/s estimates above; allow ~±3–5% file-size margin if a community release uses custom imatrix quantization.

verdict_summary: NVIDIA RTX 4060 Laptop (8GB) fits DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B cleanly at Q4_K_M with 1.94 GB headroom at 8K context (5.56 / 7.5 GB usable; max 40K context @ 7.43 GB (speed drops to ~22–35 tok/s [Fast] at 40K)). Formula throughput at 8K sits in the Fast band (est. ~31–44 tok/s) driven by 256 GB/s memory bandwidth.

context_analysis.bottleneck_summary: DeepSeek-R1 7B Q4_K_M weights occupy 4.61 GB plus 0.51 GB runtime scratchpad, and FP16 KV cache grows by +0.22 GB per 4K tokens (0.44 GB @ 8K). With 7.5 GB usable budget on RTX 4060 Laptop 8GB, max resident context reaches 40K (7.43 GB total, Tight Fit; speed @ 40K: ~22–35 tok/s).
key_points: Q4_K_M @ 8K requires 5.56 GB total (4.61 GB weights + 0.44 GB FP16 KV + 0.51 GB runtime buffer; est. ~31–44 tok/s).
Max fit context on Q4_K_M reaches 40K (7.43 GB total footprint, Tight Fit; decode @ 40K: ~22–35 tok/s [Fast]).
Higher precision Q8_0 requires 9.06 GB @ 8K (Partial Offload, est. ~8–14 tok/s).
Under vLLM AWQ 4-bit, DeepSeek-R1 7B requires 6.04 GB at 8K context (vs 7.5 GB usable — Fits, est. ~27–38 tok/s).
optimization_tips: Set FlashAttention (-fa on) and 8-bit KV cache (-ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0) to nearly halve KV memory growth per 4K tokens.
Use the Desktop vs Clean OS reserve selector above to verify safe headroom if your display or IDE shares GPU memory.
Remember all tok/s numbers are Physics v3.2 formula estimate ranges (~±15–20%); pairs without a Verified Benchmark remain Formula only (unverified).

faq.question: Does DeepSeek-R1 7B fit cleanly in RTX 4060 Laptop 8GB VRAM?
faq.answer: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B at Q4_K_M (8K context) needs 5.56 GB vs 7.5 GB usable on NVIDIA RTX 4060 Laptop (8GB). Status is Fits with 1.94 GB spare headroom (max 40K @ 7.43 GB, ~22–35 tok/s).

faq.question: What token generation speed can I expect for DeepSeek-R1 7B on RTX 4060 Laptop 8GB?
faq.answer: Physics v3.2 estimates ~31–44 tok/s (Fast) for batch=1 decoding at 8K context (slowing to ~22–35 tok/s at full 40K context). Treat this as a ±15–20% formula range unless backed by a Measured Community Benchmark.

faq.question: Can I run DeepSeek-R1 7B with AWQ (vLLM) or Apple MLX instead of GGUF?
faq.answer: Under vLLM AWQ 4-bit, DeepSeek-R1 7B requires 6.04 GB at 8K context (vs 7.5 GB usable — Fits, est. ~27–38 tok/s).

faq.question: How much context window fits safely without swapping on RTX 4060 Laptop 8GB?
faq.answer: With FP16 KV cache growing at +0.22 GB per 4K tokens, Q4_K_M clears up to 40K (7.43 GB total footprint), where decode speed adjusts from ~~31–44 tok/s (@ 8K) to ~22–35 tok/s (@ 40K) due to KV reads and attention overhead.

faq.question: Can I run an uncensored, abliterated, or Heretic variant of DeepSeek-R1 7B on RTX 4060 Laptop 8GB?
faq.answer: Yes — uncensored / abliterated / Heretic community fine-tunes of DeepSeek-R1 7B preserve identical layer counts, hidden widths, and GQA KV cache geometry. Apply the exact same 5.56 GB (Q4_K_M GGUF) or 6.04 GB (AWQ_4BIT) 8K memory and tok/s estimates above; allow ~±3–5% file-size margin if a community release uses custom imatrix quantization.

verdict_summary: NVIDIA RTX 4060 (8GB) fits Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct cleanly at Q4_K_M with 1.14 GB headroom at 8K context (6.36 / 7.5 GB usable; max 16K context @ 7.36 GB (speed drops to ~24–37 tok/s [Fast] at 16K)). Formula throughput at 8K sits in the Fast band (est. ~29–41 tok/s) driven by 272 GB/s memory bandwidth.

context_analysis.bottleneck_summary: Llama-3.1 8B Q4_K_M weights occupy 4.85 GB plus 0.51 GB runtime scratchpad, and FP16 KV cache grows by +0.50 GB per 4K tokens (1.00 GB @ 8K). With 7.5 GB usable budget on RTX 4060 8GB, max resident context reaches 16K (7.36 GB total, Tight Fit; speed @ 16K: ~24–37 tok/s).
key_points: Q4_K_M @ 8K requires 6.36 GB total (4.85 GB weights + 1.00 GB FP16 KV + 0.51 GB runtime buffer; est. ~29–41 tok/s).
Max fit context on Q4_K_M reaches 16K (7.36 GB total footprint, Tight Fit; decode @ 16K: ~24–37 tok/s [Fast]).
Higher precision Q8_0 requires 10.05 GB @ 8K (Partial Offload, est. ~6–11 tok/s).
Under vLLM AWQ 4-bit, Llama-3.1 8B requires 6.85 GB at 8K context (vs 7.5 GB usable — Tight Fit, est. ~24–37 tok/s).
optimization_tips: Set FlashAttention (-fa on) and 8-bit KV cache (-ctk q8_0 -ctv q8_0) to nearly halve KV memory growth per 4K tokens.
Use the Desktop vs Clean OS reserve selector above to verify safe headroom if your display or IDE shares GPU memory.
Remember all tok/s numbers are Physics v3.2 formula estimate ranges (~±15–20%); pairs without a Verified Benchmark remain Formula only (unverified).

faq.question: Does Llama-3.1 8B fit cleanly in RTX 4060 8GB VRAM?
faq.answer: Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct at Q4_K_M (8K context) needs 6.36 GB vs 7.5 GB usable on NVIDIA RTX 4060 (8GB). Status is Fits with 1.14 GB spare headroom (max 16K @ 7.36 GB, ~24–37 tok/s).

faq.question: What token generation speed can I expect for Llama-3.1 8B on RTX 4060 8GB?
faq.answer: Physics v3.2 estimates ~29–41 tok/s (Fast) for batch=1 decoding at 8K context (slowing to ~24–37 tok/s at full 16K context). Treat this as a ±15–20% formula range unless backed by a Measured Community Benchmark.

faq.question: Can I run Llama-3.1 8B with AWQ (vLLM) or Apple MLX instead of GGUF?
faq.answer: Under vLLM AWQ 4-bit, Llama-3.1 8B requires 6.85 GB at 8K context (vs 7.5 GB usable — Tight Fit, est. ~24–37 tok/s).

faq.question: How much context window fits safely without swapping on RTX 4060 8GB?
faq.answer: With FP16 KV cache growing at +0.50 GB per 4K tokens, Q4_K_M clears up to 16K (7.36 GB total footprint), where decode speed adjusts from ~~29–41 tok/s (@ 8K) to ~24–37 tok/s (@ 16K) due to KV reads and attention overhead.

faq.question: Can I run an uncensored, abliterated, or Heretic variant of Llama-3.1 8B on RTX 4060 8GB?
faq.answer: Yes — uncensored / abliterated / Heretic community fine-tunes of Llama-3.1 8B preserve identical layer counts, hidden widths, and GQA KV cache geometry. Apply the exact same 6.36 GB (Q4_K_M GGUF) or 6.85 GB (AWQ_4BIT) 8K memory and tok/s estimates above; allow ~±3–5% file-size margin if a community release uses custom imatrix quantization.
